messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] Elevated 5xx rate detected for hosted-api /v1/generate — anomaly starting 14:23 UTC. Error spike: 5xx 3.1% -> 18.9% over 10m. Service: model-runner-kgx-prod. Root ts: 2451234567
sara.g: paging @mike.oncall — are you able to take?
mike.oncall: oncall here, looking. grabbing logs from pod model-runner-kgx-5
mike.oncall: saw repeated SIGSEGV in runtime, GPU OOMs, and kernel retries. attaching tail:
```
[14:23:01] model-runner: decode_batch() at batch_executor.cpp:312
[14:23:02] runtime: GPU 0 OOM allocating 5.2GB
[14:23:03] runtime: segfault (signal 11) in tensor_ops.cu:482
[14:23:05] k8s: evicted container model-runner-kgx-5 exit code 139
```
nina: adding context — traffic spike from a new customer test cluster + longer seq lengths. preds show median seq len 2048 -> 6400.
dinesh: looks like the KV cache growth killed the process. might be batching + long-seq compounding.
mike.oncall: mitigation plan:
- disable cross-request batching on hostpool (scale down batch_size)
- route traffic for model-id "kgx-large" to fallback "kgx-medium-quant" in routing rules
- restart failing pods, cordon node if bad GPU
emma-sev: executing rollout now: updating route rule:
```
/v1/generate?model=kgx-large -> kgx-medium-quant (5m canary)
```
ops-bot: scaling: replicas model-runner-kgx -> 8 -> 12 pods (requested)
sara.g: customer impact: ~12 customers reported 504s, internal SLO alerts triggered. CS informed. preparing incident bridge.
mike.oncall: applied fallback routing and disabled batching. observed error rate drop to 4.5% within 90s.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: error rate trending down; 5xx now 4.5% (was 18.9%) — monitoring for 15m.
nina: root cause hypothesis: kernel-level OOM on GPUs due to unbounded KV cache + long seqs + aggressive batch packing after recent autoscaling change.
dinesh: follow-ups:
- add hard KV cache cap per-request (config PR)
- better preflight seq-length validation + reject with 4xx if over threshold
- add kernel OOM alerts to oncall-runbook
mike.oncall: handoff to nina for postmortem + RCA. taking notes on bridge. handing off at 14:47 UTC.
sara.g: nina you're assigned. please confirm postmortem window and customer comms owner.
nina: confirmed. will take postmortem, will coordinate CS for the impacted customer set. thanks everyone.
ops-bot: deploy job model-runner-kgx@restart completed in 24s.
mike.oncall: :thumbsup: closing active paging. monitoring 30m then wrap.
